name: Raptorfall: Survival
detailed_description:
You crash on an alien planet. Your ship is destroyed. Dangerous, raptor-like predators roam the land. Your goal is simple: survive.

Explore the crash zone and surrounding biomes to scavenge resources, locate lost supply crates, and recover broken ship parts. Use salvaged materials to craft tools, weapons, defenses, and technology.

Build and fortify your base. Place walls, traps, and automated defenses. Power your systems using generators and alien fuel cells. Each night, or during random events, predators will attack. They test your defenses, adapt to weak points, and become stronger over time.

Key mechanics:

Base Building: Modular building system with structural integrity and upgrade tiers.

Scavenging: Ship debris and lootboxes scattered across the map with randomized gear.

Defense & Combat: Deploy traps, turrets, and weapons to defend against coordinated predator waves.

Crafting System: Gather resources to create tools, weapons, ammo, armor, and upgrades.

Power & Systems: Manage energy sources to keep defenses, doors, and lights operational.

Enemy AI: Raptors can stalk, ambush, and coordinate attacks. Some evolve or mutate.

Survival Loop: Eat, heal, and maintain gear. Fortify daily. Prepare for nightfall.
